title: 第11章 吕布在世第12章 就你也想当牛头人
lines: 长剑破空而来，蓝雨伯挥鞭绕过长剑抽向乐临清的身体，鞭梢撕裂空气发出尖锐啸音，逼迫着她调转剑势。
但乐临清剑锋一转，斩向长鞭，虽然这是在半空中，没有着力点，可长剑的锋利还是将长鞭给硬生生斩断了。
这不由令蓝雨伯心中有些滴血，但这也成功浪费了乐临清积蓄的一剑。
她还能再出几剑呢？
迷神欲雾化作锁链，再度攻向乐临清，虽然在神陨之地，这雾气很快就会消散，但凝缩成锁链，还能维持片刻。
只要调动起乐临清体内的欲神瘴，这场战斗蓝雨伯就赢了。
而一切也正如蓝雨伯所料，乐临清根本不敢正面触碰锁链，只能闪避，出剑也因此束手束脚。
正当蓝雨伯觉得胜券在握的时候，背后却传来一阵怪异的叫声。
“喔喔喔！”
许平秋手持着一根地上捡起的长树杈，骑着白虎冲来，通过吼叫吸引了蓝雨伯的注意。
蓝雨伯一开始没把许平秋当回事，但是看清树杈上的东西后，脸色瞬间一黑，因为这绿油油的树杈上，竟然还有附魔！
正所谓拖把沾屎犹如吕布在世，此刻胯骑白虎，手持沾屎树杈的许平秋便宛如吕布骑典韦，天下无敌！
“阁下的迷神欲雾的确很强，可我若是树杈沾屎，阁下又该如何应对呢？”
许平秋逆着光线，犹如天神下凡，白虎凶恶的呲牙，一副勇往直前之态，骁勇如百战之兵。
但暗地里，许平秋揪着白虎的皮毛，暗示它向旁边闪避，不要直冲过去送人头。
“给我去死！”
正如许平秋料定的一样，蓝雨伯见到树杈上的污物，加上冲骑之势，一种威胁和恶心油然而生。
顿时，她一掌毫无保留的拍出，灵力汹涌，准备先将许平秋这个搅屎棍弄死。
但在许平秋的暗示下，白虎十分有灵性的明白了他的想法。
冲到一半，它屁股一扭就往回跑，甚至还冲蓝雨伯放了个屁，来了个氮气加速，令她一掌打空，气得牙痒痒。
而在她身后的乐临清也趁势提剑直冲，蓝雨伯无奈，只得转身又凝聚出数根锁链攻向乐临清。
但乐临清也不傻，也只是佯攻。
虽然欲神瘴的效果在渐渐加强，令她感到双腿发软，但只要不调动灵力出剑，只是闪避的话，还能再坚持一段时间。
一来二去，蓝雨伯反倒陷入颓势，接连调用灵力和迷神欲雾对她的消耗也很大。
“陈大朋，还不快滚过来帮忙！”蓝雨伯大喊道，此时她终于想起还有一个家伙能驱使，同时控制着那头妖兽的幻觉，向着她靠近。
“摇人是吧，吔屎啦雷！”
许平秋与白虎腰马合一，趁着她张嘴，一记精准的送刺，树杈精准的糊到了蓝雨伯的脸，给她来了一套妖兽至尊美容粪便面膜。
此刻，许平秋觉得自己真是帅炸了。
“你他妈……哕！”
被糊一脸的蓝雨伯踉跄后退两步，下意识想说什么狠话，但还没说完，浓烈腥臊就直冲鼻腔，喉头剧烈滚动，直接被干哕了。
她疯狂催动灵力冲刷，将污秽涤除，可哪怕再干净，心中还是一阵反胃。
“哟吼，还骂人是吧，你等着，我再去给你上菜，好好的给你洗洗嘴。”
许平秋开着嘲讽，驾驭着白虎再度转身就跑，尽管它灵智未彻底开化，但此刻，它也感受到了一种莫名的快乐。
它很欢快的就带着许平秋向刚刚附魔的地方赶去，准备给蓝雨伯再来一发热乎的。
“啊啊啊！我一定要杀了你！”
蓝雨伯怒喝着冲向许平秋，打算先把他弄死，她纵横魔道多年，就没见过这般天生贱种，贱的她没法忍。
但身后的乐临清却又趁势近身，一剑斩来，蓝雨伯恼怒上头，竟转身要与乐临清硬碰硬。
桃粉的雾气骤然爆发，但是乐临清一剑也斩中了蓝雨伯的胸膛，一道深长的伤势贯彻在她的胸口。
乐临清一剑立功，当即就向后退去，躲过迷神欲雾的影响，但从她的脸色上看，显然又糟糕了一些。
content_en:
The long sword came through the air. Lan Yubo swung his whip around the long sword and whipped it towards Le Linqing's body. The tip of the whip tore through the air and made a sharp whistle, forcing her to turn the sword.
But Le Linqing's sword edge turned and slashed towards the long whip. Although it was in mid-air and there was no point of force, the sharpness of the long sword still cut off the long whip abruptly.
This couldn't help but make Lan Yubo's heart bleed, but it also successfully wasted the sword that Le Linqing had saved up.
How many more swords can she use?
The mist of lust turned into chains and attacked Le Linqing again. Although the mist would dissipate quickly in the Land of God's Fall, it could still last for a while if it condensed into chains.
As long as the Miasma of Desire within Le Linqing's body is mobilized, Lan Yubo will win this battle.
And everything was just as Lan Yubo expected, Le Linqing didn't dare to touch the chain head-on, so he could only dodge, and was constrained in drawing the sword.
Just when Lan Yubo felt that he had a chance to win, a strange cry came from behind.
"Oh oh oh!"
Xu Pingqiu held a long tree branch picked up from the ground and rushed towards him on a white tiger. He attracted Lan Yubo's attention by roaring.
"You?!"
Lan Yubo didn't take Xu Pingqiu seriously at first, but after he saw what was on the tree branch, his face instantly darkened, because there was actually an enchantment on the green tree branch!
As the saying goes, a mop stained with feces is like Lu Bu in the world. At this moment, riding a white tiger on his hip and holding a tree branch stained with feces, Xu Pingqiu is like Lu Bu riding Dian Wei, invincible in the world!
"Your ecstasy is indeed very strong, but if I get poop on a tree branch, how should you deal with it?"
Xu Pingqiu looked against the light, as if a god descended to earth. The white tiger's ferocious teeth showed an attitude of marching forward bravely, as brave as a soldier in a hundred battles.
But secretly, Xu Pingqiu grabbed the white tiger's fur and hinted it to dodge to the side and not to rush forward and kill someone.
"Go to hell!"
Just as Xu Pingqiu expected, when Lan Yubo saw the dirt on the branches of the tree and the momentum of charging, a sense of threat and disgust arose spontaneously.
Suddenly, she slapped out a palm without reservation, her spiritual power surged, and she was ready to kill Xu Pingqiu, the troublemaker first.
But under Xu Pingqiu's hint, Bai Hu understood his thoughts very spiritually.
In the middle of the charge, it twisted its butt and ran back, and even farted at Lan Yubo. It accelerated with nitrogen, causing her to hit the air with her palm, making her teeth itch with anger.
Le Linqing, who was behind her, also took advantage of the situation and charged forward with his sword. Lan Yubo had no choice but to turn around and gather several chains to attack Le Linqing.
But Le Linqing wasn't stupid, it was just a feint.
Although the effects of the Miasma of Desire were gradually strengthening, making her legs feel weak, she could still hold on for a while as long as she did not use her spiritual power to draw the sword and just dodge.
Over and over again, Lan Yubo fell into decline, and the continuous use of spiritual power and ecstasy was very draining on her.
"Chen Dapeng, come here and help!" Lan Yubo shouted. At this time, she finally remembered that there was another guy who could drive and control the illusion of the monster and approach her.
"Shake people, right? Shit La Lei!"
Xu Pingqiu merged with the white tiger's waist horse, and when she opened her mouth, he stabbed Lan Yubo accurately with a precise thrust, and gave her a set of the Monster Supreme Beauty Faeces Mask.
At this moment, Xu Pingqiu felt that he was so handsome.
"You...fuck!"
The confused Lan Yubo staggered back two steps, subconsciously wanting to say something cruel, but before he could finish speaking, a strong smell rushed straight into his nose, his throat rolled violently, and he was fucked directly.
She frantically activated her spiritual power to wash away the dirt, but no matter how clean it was, she still felt nauseated.
"Hey, you're still swearing, right? Just wait, I'll serve you some food and wash your mouth properly."
Xu Pingqiu taunted and drove the white tiger to turn around and run away again. Although its intelligence was not completely enlightened, at this moment, it also felt an inexplicable happiness.
It happily took Xu Pingqiu to the place where it had just been enchanted, preparing to give Lan Yubo another warm blow.
"Ahh! I must kill you!"
Lan Yubo shouted angrily and rushed towards Xu Pingqiu, intending to kill him first. She had been in the devil's way for many years, and she had never seen such a born bitch. She was so mean that she couldn't bear it.
But Le Linqing behind him took advantage of the situation and came closer, slashing with his sword. Lan Yubo got angry and turned around to confront Le Linqing head-on.
The peach powder mist suddenly erupted, but Le Linqing also hit Lan Yubo's chest with a sword, and a deep wound penetrated her chest.
Le Linqing made a good move with her sword and immediately stepped back to avoid the influence of the fog of lust, but judging from her face, it was obviously a little worse.
title_en: Chapter 11 Lu Bu is alive Chapter 12 You also want to be a tauren
